notes.title: Update Release 1.0
notes.notes:
CHANGELOG

Platforming changes:

    Gravity increased
    Added double jump
    Slow near walls
    Particle cloud effect while moving, against walls, and double jumping
    Enemy death cloud particle

Make abilities easier:

    Miner
        Bomb collision
        Miner changed to Tiki Mask including all ability visuals
       

    Witch
        Bats optimized
            Damage now deals flat rate
            Cooldown reduced by 60%
            Spread narrowed
            wizard dove visual change
        Broom
            Broom key no longer needs to be held
            Press key again to release
            Changing direction no longer reduces speed
       

    Skeleton
        Boomerang cd reduced
        Melee strikes damage increased

    Tree
        Basic spell now correctly triggers as a passive
            also now does persistent damage while circling


Text Replacements:

    Bottle and gold ui added to bottom left corner       

    General text

    UI based text

    Altered tutorial text in first level

    General UI fixes for boss level and act selection



Songs:

    8 new songs added to levels
        Mostly boss music


Pets:
   
    5 pet attack types
    20 pet varieties one for each mask/costume
   

Leveling:
   
    1 quarter heart per every odd level
    pet unlocked at level 8

Item Balance changes

Price Changes
    Mask prices reduced
    Item prices drastically reduced

Final boss
    Sound effects added
    More health, brick skulls are now less exploitable 

plus more undocumented changes

notes.title: Alpha 2.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Due to a crash report, this patch has been reverted till further testing

Notes:
On the way to the new game mode arcade, coming next patch. Here is some holiday content, and a few balance changes to bring in the holiday season.

Content: 

-Two new masks
Santa
	King alt skin
Gingerbread 
	Snowman alt skin

-Three Christmas loot items
	25% drop on boss kill

-Wizard
	New spell particle effect


Balance changes

-Cake Boss
		Player hp healths on present arrival
		
		Top layers attack has been adjusted
			greatly reduced rate of fire
			cake projectile destroys on player contact

-Boss loot
		drop rates adjusted, no more white tier drops

notes.title: Hot Fixes 11.1.2016
notes.notes:
Balancing: 

Player 
        - health increased by 1 heart.
Bee queen
        - wasp spawn health reduced to 8 from 16. 
        - additional health crate added.
Forest tree boss
        - time between attacks increased 
        - additional health crate added.
Bee/Scarecrow mask, 
        - bees/bats will leash after 20 ticks off screen
        - releasing (W/Y) ability early with jump, additional upward momentum
Pirate level
        - crab health reduced
        - crab rider fish projectiles now destroy after damaging player
        - crab hitbox should be more precise

Bugs: 

Bug fixed crash caused by ending level with bee player projectile present
Bug fixed causing cathedral boss skells health to regenerate to 75%
